name: Golden Designs Zurich 4-Person Barrel Sauna
description: Golden Designs Zurich 4-Person Barrel Sauna Discover the epitome of relaxation and luxury with the Golden Designs Zurich 4-Person Barrel Sauna. Designed for your well-being, this exquisite traditional sauna offers a serene escape for you and your loved ones to unwind and revitalize. Pure Pacific Cedar: Immerse yourself in the luxurious embrace of Pacific Cedar as you enter the soothing interior of the Zurich sauna. The aromatic cedar and smooth texture add to the sauna experience, enveloping you in a world of comfort and tranquility. Spacious Capacity: Designed for shared experiences, the Zurich sauna comfortably accommodates 4 individuals. Gather your family or friends and revel in the joy of togetherness while indulging in the rejuvenating benefits of sauna therapy. Crafted to Perfection: The Zurich sauna is a masterpiece of craftsmanship, boasting attention to detail and quality materials. The sturdy construction ensures longevity, while the tempered glass door bathes the interior in natural light, creating an inviting and rejuvenating ambiance. Elevate Your Well-Being: Elevate your well-being with the Golden Designs Zurich 4-Person Barrel Sauna. Allow the gentle warmth to envelop your body, promoting relaxation and detoxification. Experience the therapeutic benefits of traditional sauna therapy and embrace the serenity of the Zurich sauna. Rediscover the art of relaxation, embrace modern sophistication, and elevate your well-being with the Zurich sauna - your gateway to pure rejuvenation and tranquility. Features 4 person capacity Pacific Premium Cedar wood construction Custom Acrylic Bronze Privacy Rear Wall Interior backrest with accent lighting Sandglass, thermometer, bucket and scoop Stainless steel hinge and handle Harvia SWS80 The Wall 8 kW Traditional Sauna Stove with Built in Controls Specifications Electrical service: 240V / 30AMP (Stove) and 120V / 15AMP (Control for Lights and Music). Please consult a certified electrician to install. Assembled Dimensions (W x D x H): 75" x 73" x 80" Shipping Dimensions with Stove (W x D x H): 74" x 44" x 38" Assembled Weight: 595 lbs Shipping Weight: 675 lbs All Golden Designs Saunas Include a 5-Year Limited Warranty. View more details here. What are you waiting for? Order your sauna today and experience the Golden Designs difference.
